member.summary:

This pool acts as a local cache layer on top of a global . It minimizes contention and allocations by keeping a fixed-size array of reusable objects bound to a specific connection.

Blocking = true

member.name: T:Nalix.Network.Options.NetworkCallbackOptions
member.summary:
Configuration options for the AsyncCallback dispatcher and per-connection receive throttle in FramedSocketConnection.
DDoS protection tuning:
These values control two independent throttle layers:
Layer 1 — per-connection packet queue cap (). Packets from a single connection that arrive faster than the protocol handler can process them are dropped at the receive loop before they ever reach the ThreadPool.
Layer 2 — global and per-IP callback caps (, ). Enforced inside AsyncCallback.Invoke; close/disconnect events always bypass these limits via InvokeHighPriority.

member.name: P:Nalix.Network.Options.NetworkCallbackOptions.MaxPerConnectionPendingPackets
member.summary:
Maximum number of packets that may be queued-but-not-yet-processed for a single connection at any moment.
When a connection sends packets faster than the protocol handler can consume them the excess packets are dropped at the receive loop and a warning is logged. Legitimate clients rarely have more than 1–2 packets in-flight simultaneously; the default of 16 gives generous headroom while blocking flood attacks.

member.name: P:Nalix.Network.Options.NetworkCallbackOptions.MaxPerConnectionOpenFragmentStreams
member.summary: Maximum number of concurrently open fragmented streams per connection.

member.summary: Action will be executed when the number of pending packets for a connection exceeds .

member.name: P:Nalix.Network.Options.NetworkCallbackOptions.MaxPendingNormalCallbacks
member.summary:
Maximum total normal-priority callbacks that may be pending in AsyncCallback simultaneously across all connections.
High-priority close/disconnect callbacks are never counted against this limit and are always dispatched immediately.

member.name: P:Nalix.Network.Options.NetworkCallbackOptions.CallbackWarningThreshold
member.summary: Emit a warning log every time pending normal callbacks reaches a multiple of this value. Set to 0 to disable warnings.

member.summary:
Maximum normal-priority callbacks pending for a single remote IP.
Callbacks from that IP are dropped once this threshold is exceeded, regardless of how much global headroom remains. This prevents one attacker IP from monopolising the global callback quota and starving legitimate connections.
